ROUTE_IDENTITY.detail: The route key obligation:track-pathway:HI:hi_nonconviction_expungement:nonconviction-arrest-expungement is identical in the MASTER_QUEUE.json family row and in production-field-map.json, and both record implementationStrategy participant_agency_application, so there is no queue-versus-record disagreement here. The paper is HCJDC 159(b) Rev. 06/03/2026, which carries BOTH statutory branches, and the packet is unambiguously built for the non-conviction branch: the field map declares the HRS 831-3.2 paragraph's initial cell REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING for the participant, and declares the first-time drug/property/DUI-under-21 CONVICTION paragraph and its court-order checklist item NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE with a named condition taken from what the form itself prints - that such applications require an attached court order granting expungement of a conviction, which this route never produces. Both guides state the route in the same terms.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: The controlling record's packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling for hi_nonconviction_expungement carries eight items. Six are named in the delivered guides in substance, which I accept as naming them even though not verbatim: the photo identification (participant-instructions.md checklist item and filing-instructions.md 'A copy of your valid official government-issued photo ID'), the money order (both files, with the form's own payable-to wording), the stamped self-addressed envelope (both files), the signature and its date, the applicant signing personally, and the application fee. TWO ARE ABSENT FROM THE ENTIRE FAMILY DIRECTORY. (1) 'The source review does not state a notarization requirement.' Nothing in either guide says this. The only occurrence of the word in the family is the closing sentence 'No part of this application has been signed, initialled, dated, notarised or adopted by anyone', which if anything leaves a reader thinking notarisation may be required; the record settles that it is not stated, and the packet does not pass that on. (2) 'The source review does not address a fee waiver.' Also absent, and scored again under FEE_AND_WAIVER because the same missing line is what leaves that obligation unmet; one repair discharges both, and I am not counting it twice as two separate defects. I confirmed the absence by grepping the whole family directory: 'fee waiver' and 'notarization' as the record phrases them appear nowhere in it.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: This form's route mark is not a check box a preparer may tick: it is an INITIAL CELL beside a sworn paragraph, and the paragraph it belongs to contains 'I hereby declare that I am not a fugitive from justice'. The build leaves it blank, classifies it REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with routeDetermined false, and states the reason - no packet may write an applicant's initials on a sworn declaration. That is the correct treatment, and it is the treatment that keeps PROTECTED_FIELDS sound; writing the initials would be a far graver defect than leaving them. What the obligation then requires is that the election not be silently dropped, and it is not: the route is stated in the field map's routeSelectionNote, in participant-instructions.md's header and required-before-filing list ('write your initials in this cell - it is the paragraph this packet is built for, and initialling it is your own sworn declaration'), and in filing-instructions.md. The other paragraph's initial cell and its court-order checklist item are declared not applicable with named conditions. No refusal in the family carries routeDetermined true, and I confirmed from the bytes that neither initial cell and none of the five checklist boxes carries any added ink on either fixture.

REPEATING_ROWS.detail: HCJDC 159(b) carries no repeating row group - no arrest table, no charge table, no multi-row grid. The nearest thing is the five-item 'Before submitting the application, confirm these items are complete' checklist, and all five boxes are wholly empty on both fixtures, so there is no half-completed row and no row that reads as finished when it is not. Zero incomplete rows is a measurement here, not a default.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.detail: Measured by differencing every word box of the official source page against the delivered page on both fixtures, then testing every added word against every refusal area the field map measures. Canonical adds 18 words and removes none; boundary adds 25 and removes none. ZERO added words fall inside any refusal area on either fixture. Specifically blank in the delivered bytes: the Signature line (measured area x 36-233.15 at baseline 104.3), the Date beside it (245.2-344.7), both initial cells (36-67.32 at baselines 261.5 and 217.2), all five checklist boxes, and the area the form prints 'LEAVE BLANK; HCJDC USE ONLY' across (406.8-572.9). The four words my differencing flagged as outside every write rectangle are at the very foot of the page and turn out to be the form's own printed submission address - 'Hawaii Criminal Justice Data Center, Attn: Expungement / 465 South King Street, Room 102 / Honolulu, HI 96813' - identical in the source and the delivered file, flagged only because the canonical participant's own address repeats the words Street, Honolulu, HI and 96813.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: The record's destination is {kind: agency, name: 'Hawaii Criminal Justice Data Center'}. filing-instructions.md names it by quoting the form's own submission block, which I verified is printed on the delivered page: 'Submit completed application along with a self-addressed stamped envelope to: Hawaii Criminal Justice Data Center, Attn: Expungement, 465 South King Street, Room 102, Honolulu, HI 96813.' It also states the outcome mode correctly - an application to a state agency, not a petition to a court.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: The fee half is well done. The record says only 'An application fee applies, paid by money order. The source review does not state the amount', and rather than stop there the packet reports the form's own printed schedule with attribution: $35 first-time, $50 non-first-time, $20 duplicate certificate, $10 of it non-refundable, payable by money order or cashier's check issued in the United States to 'State of Hawaii', personal checks not accepted, and a refund of all but the $10 if the application is denied. I confirmed every one of those figures is printed on the delivered page and is not added ink. The waiver half is absent. The controlling record carries an apply_fee_waiver item reading 'The source review does not address a fee waiver', conditional, 'Applies only when the participant cannot pay the filing fee', requiredBeforeFiling true - and neither participant-instructions.md nor filing-instructions.md mentions a fee waiver at all. A grep of the whole family directory for 'fee waiver' and for 'waiver' returns nothing. So a participant who cannot raise $35 is told the payment is mandatory and is told nothing about whether any relief from it exists, where the record has an answer to give. Compare the two families I read this shift whose records carry the identical line: az_certificate_second_chance-set and fl-self-defense-set both print it and both tell the participant what to do about it.

SERVICE.detail: filing-instructions.md answers both limbs directly and correctly for an agency route: 'No party is served. This is an agency application; there is no opposing party and no certificate of service.' I confirmed from the delivered bytes that the form carries no certificate-of-service block and that nothing service-shaped is written. What must accompany the application instead of service is stated in the same file and matches the record's own file item: the photo identification, the payment, the self-addressed stamped envelope and the disposition documentation. The guide also carries the form's printed post-submission facts - the certificate mailed to the address provided within 120 days under HRS 831-3.2(a), and that no status is given by phone or email.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: The packet never states where self-help ends. The controlling record names exactly two selfHelpStopConditions for this track, identical in selfHelpBoundaries: 'The record is federal, military, or from another jurisdiction.' and 'Any immigration matter.' NEITHER APPEARS ANYWHERE IN THE FAMILY. I grepped the whole family directory case-insensitively: 'immigration' returns nothing and 'federal' returns nothing, in participant-instructions.md, filing-instructions.md and every other file. There is no 'stop and get help' section and no sentence anywhere telling the participant to stop and speak to a Hawaii lawyer. The closest text is the closing heading 'Nothing in this packet is legal advice, and nothing in it is approved for filing on your behalf', which is a disclaimer about what the packet is, not a statement of the point at which a self-represented applicant should stop. The section headed 'When this route does not apply' does not fill the gap either: it lists route-determining facts (exact disposition and statutory subsection, first-time status, treatment completion, deferred-acceptance or bail-forfeiture exception, statutory exclusions), which is eligibility, not a stop. The omission bites: the first condition is precisely the case an HCJDC application cannot reach, because a federal, military or out-of-state record is outside the statewide repository this route clears, and the second is the standard immigration hard stop that every other guide I read this shift carries. This is the same failure mode VF03, VF04 and VF05 scored on the Illinois families - a guide whose stop section carries fewer conditions than the record names - except that here it carries none of them.
